prompt: Starting at the phase-selection function, the engineer follows an incoming ‘represents’ link back to INT-MOD-001. What belongs in the change review?

options.text: Record the model as a candidate for review of its fixed phase sequence.
options.feedback: E03 points from the model to the function it represents. Following that link backward identifies the model whose assumptions the reviewer should inspect.

options.text: Record a new link saying the function represents the model.
options.feedback: The search began at the target of E03. Its recorded direction still runs from the model to the function.

options.text: Record a finding that the adaptive proposal invalidates the model.
options.feedback: A finding of incompatibility requires comparing the proposed behavior with the model assumptions. E03 gives the engineer a reason to start that review.

prompt: The graph lists INT-IF-001 as a possible impact. A suggested second link names INT-IF-UNKNOWN. How should the engineer handle that second link?

options.text: Use INT-IF-001 as the target because its name is similar.
options.feedback: E08 already identifies INT-IF-001. Resolving the second ID requires a source that establishes which interface it denotes.

options.text: Mark the interface question as settled because no object has that ID.
options.feedback: A failed lookup identifies a gap in the records. The interface owner may know which definition or correction is needed.

options.text: Keep the question open and ask for the defining source before adding the link.
options.feedback: The source flags INT-IF-UNKNOWN as unresolved. When the interface owner identifies the target, the reviewer can decide whether to record the link.

prompt: INT-TST-001 targets the rule against simultaneous greens. Which statement does that link support?

options.text: The fixed-phase model passed the check in T1.
options.feedback: A pass needs a recorded execution with the model revision, the criterion and the observed outcome. The link records only the check's purpose.

options.text: The proposed check addresses the rule. Its outcome is still open.
options.feedback: E06 records the target property and marks the check as proposed and unrun. A later result could be linked to the exact revision examined.

options.text: The check covers the behavior of the proposed adaptive controller.
options.feedback: The target is one property. To claim coverage for another strategy, the reviewer would need its behavior definition and the conditions the check examines.
